description: Check if a domain name is available and its price. Use when the user looks for a domain name to buy. Before: nothing. Returns a job; read its result with get_job (needs job read access): available true means the registry confirmed the name is free; status unknown (or a job status uncertain) means the registry did not confirm it: price it with quote_domain (needs domain quote access) or check again later. Scope: domain:lookup. Cost: free.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request. Reuse it on retry.

name: check_domain
title: Check a domain name
